reviews.author: Brenda N.
reviews.text: Daniel and his staff at D Fine Cabinetry were amazing to work with when remodeling our entire home. He listened to what I wanted and designed quality cabinets exactly the way I had envisioned.

reviews.author: Tanner V.
reviews.text: If you’re looking for top-notch customer service and great quality work look no further. My wife and I couldn’t be happier with our custom cabinets and kitchen remodel. The quality and the craftsmanship are top-notch. Not to mention all of the questions that we had which were explained to us very clearly, and there was no second-guessing on anything.

reviews.author: Carolyn B.
reviews.text: I have used D’Fine Cabinetry for several projects because they do such amazing work. Not only is the work beautiful, but they are great at communicating and won’t leave the job until you are 100% satisfied. I would highly recommend D’Fine Cabinetry.

reviews.author: Meg T.
reviews.text: This is such a great cabinet company! Daniele the owner is so great to work with. His years in the industry shine through when you meet with him to plan out every room in your home. We love all the work he has done for us and would highly recommend him to anyone that is planning on building a home or doing any renovations!

reviews.author: Lynne B.
reviews.text: Dfine did a beautiful job on our kitchen cabinets several years ago, and we have had them return several times for tweaks and upgrades. They are always a pleasure to deal with, and respond promptly when needed.

reviews.author: Armand D.
reviews.text: Dfine cabinetry did a fantastic job on our kitchen cabinets, and we couldn’t be happier with how they turned out. We get compliments from everyone who sees them. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Rodi P.
reviews.text: Dan has always been amazing to work with! We have worked with him on multiple projects over 20 years and the quality is unmatched. Dan and his team always go above and beyond to achieve our vision!
